## Model Overview

Not sure which model to use? This comparison will help:

| Model | Purpose | Best For | Input Limit | Speed | Links |
|-------|---------|----------|-------------|-------|-------|
| **ESMC** | Sequence representation | Embeddings, function prediction, fine-tuning | 2,048 aa | Fast | [Card](https://biohub.ai/models/esmc) \| [Paper](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.01.09.632079v1) \| [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/biohub) |
| **ESM3** | Multimodal design | Sequence generation, structure prediction | 2,048 aa | Medium | [Card](https://biohub.ai/models/esm3) \| [Paper](https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adk2211) |
| **ESM2** | Sequence representation | Legacy code, established workflows | 2,048 aa | Fast | [Card](https://biohub.ai/models/esm2) \| [Paper](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2022.07.20.500902v1) |
| **ESMFold** | Structure prediction | Quick structure predictions | Single chain | Very Fast | [Card](https://biohub.ai/models/esmfold) |
| **ESMFold2** | Complex prediction | Antibody-antigen, multimers | Up to 768 aa | Fast | [Card](https://biohub.ai/models/esmfold2) |
| **ESMFold2-Fast** | Fast structure prediction | High-throughput screening | Single chain | Fastest | [Card](https://biohub.ai/models/esmfold2) |

---

## Choose Your Model

:::{#decision-tree}

### What do you want to do?

**I need protein sequence embeddings or representations**
→ Use **ESMC** or **ESM2** ([Embeddings Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials))

**I want to design new proteins or generate sequences**
→ Use **ESM3** ([Design Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials))

**I need to predict protein 3D structure**

- *Single chain?* → Use **ESMFold** or **ESMFold2** ([Structure Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials))
- *Complex (antibody-antigen, multimer)?* → Use **ESMFold2** ([Complex Prediction Tutorial](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials))
- *Need maximum speed?* → Use **ESMFold2-Fast** ([Performance Guide](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials))

**I'm working with legacy code**
→ Use **ESM2** ([Migration Guide](docs/get-started/decision-tree.qmd))

**I want to fine-tune a model**
→ Use **ESMC** ([Fine-tuning Guide](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials))

:::

---

## Installation

### Quick Start

```bash
# Install the ESM package
pip install esm

# Or from GitHub for latest version
pip install git+https://github.com/Biohub/esm.git@main
```

Requirements

Python 3.10+
PyTorch 2.0+
CUDA 11.8+ (for GPU acceleration)

For detailed setup instructions, see the Installation Guide.
